network: The connection dropped before the server answered. Check the connection, then tap again: nothing is sent twice.
unknown: That did not work. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your manager.
NOT_AUTHORIZED: Your account can't do this. Ask the cashier or your manager.
REQUEST_ID_REQUIRED: The app sent an incomplete request. Reload the app and try again.
REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Check the order before sending again.
SETTINGS_MISSING: The restaurant settings are missing. Tell your manager.
ORDER_TYPE_REQUIRED: Choose Dine-In or Take Away first.
ORDER_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This kind of order can't be taken here yet.
TABLE_REQUIRED: Choose a table for a Dine-In order.
TABLE_NOT_ALLOWED: A Take Away order has no table.
TABLE_NOT_FOUND: That table is not in use any more. Go back to Tables and choose another.
TABLE_HAS_OPEN_ORDER: This table already has an open order. Go back to Tables and open it there.
TABLE_SAME: The order is already on that table.
CUSTOMER_DETAILS_INVALID: The customer's name or phone is too long. Shorten it and try again.
WAITER_INVALID: That waiter is not active. Choose another waiter.
WAITER_NOT_ALLOWED: Only Dine-In orders have a waiter.
ITEMS_TOO_MANY: That is too many lines for one send. Send part of the order first, then add the rest.
ITEM_INVALID: One of the items could not be read. Remove it and add it again.
ITEM_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: One of the items could not be read. Remove it and add it again.
ITEM_NOT_FOUND: An item is no longer on the menu. Remove it and try again.
ITEM_UNAVAILABLE: An item in this order is sold out. Remove it, then send again.
QUANTITY_INVALID: Each quantity must be between 1 and 99.
NOTES_INVALID: A note is too long. Keep notes under 200 characters.
ORDER_NOT_FOUND: This order can't be found any more. Go back and check the table.
ORDER_CLOSED: This order is already closed. Go back and check the table.
ORDER_ALREADY_PAID: This bill is already paid. Ask the cashier if something needs to change.
ORDER_NOT_PAID: The bill is not paid yet. Take the payment first.
ORDER_STATUS_INVALID: This can't be done at the order's current stage. Check the order and try again.
ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED: Food that is ready can't be cancelled as a whole order. Cancel single items instead.
ORDER_NUMBER_NEEDS_DATE: The order number could not be made. Tell your manager.
BUSINESS_DATE_NEEDS_TIME: The business day could not be worked out. Tell your manager.
STATUS_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: The order has moved on since you opened it. Check its status and try again.
KITCHEN_STATUS_USE_BATCHES: Preparing and Ready are set by the kitchen on each batch.
BATCH_NOT_FOUND: That kitchen ticket can't be found any more.
BATCH_STATUS_INVALID: A kitchen ticket can only move to Preparing or Ready.
BATCH_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: That kitchen ticket has moved on. Check its status and try again.
REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason is too long. Keep it under 300 characters.
DISCOUNT_INVALID: Enter a discount of zero or more.
DISCOUNT_TOO_LARGE: The discount can't be more than the bill.
SUBTOTAL_INVALID: The bill could not be worked out. Tell your manager.
ROUNDING_UNIT_INVALID: The rounding setting is wrong. Tell your manager.
ROUNDING_NEEDS_NON_NEGATIVE_VALUE: The bill could not be rounded. Tell your manager.
NOTHING_TO_PAY: There is nothing left to pay on this bill.
TENDERS_TOO_MANY: Too many payment parts. Use fewer.
TENDER_INVALID: One of the payments could not be read. Enter it again.
TENDER_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: One of the payments could not be read. Enter it again.
TENDER_METHOD_INVALID: Choose Cash or Card for each payment.
TENDER_AMOUNT_INVALID: Each payment must be more than zero.
TENDERED_INVALID: The cash received must be at least the cash amount.
REFERENCE_INVALID: The card reference is too long. Keep it to 64 characters.
PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The payments must add up to the total exactly.
PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND: That payment can't be found any more.
PAYMENT_IMMUTABLE: A recorded payment can't be changed. An admin can void it.
PAYMENT_VOID_ON_INSERT: A new payment can't be voided at once. Record it first.
PAYMENT_RECEIVER_NOT_ALLOWED: Only the cashier or an admin can take payments.
VOID_REQUIRES_ADMIN: Only an admin can void a payment.
MOVE_NOTHING_TO_CHANGE: Choose a new table or a new waiter.
MOVE_DINE_IN_ONLY: Only Dine-In orders can change table.
USERNAME_INVALID: That username can't be used. Use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already taken. Choose another.
PROFILE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This staff account could not be set up. Tell your manager.
